title: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna
title_hi: राजर्षि छत्रपति शाहू महाराज शिक्षण शुल्क छात्रवृत्ति योजना
title_mr: राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज शिक्षण शुल्क शिष्यवृत्ती योजना (ईबीसी)
ministry: Higher and Technical Education Department Government of Maharashtra
target_audience: Economically Weaker and Open/OBC Higher Education Students
description: Financial assistance providing 50% tuition fee and exam fee reimbursement to students admitted under higher education professional/non-professional degree and diploma courses in Maharashtra.
benefits_summary: 50% tuition fee and 50% exam fee reimbursement transferred directly to verified bank account (DBT).

title: Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students (MahaDBT)
title_hi: ओबीसी छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति योजना
title_mr: इतर मागासवर्गीय (OBC) विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी मॅट्रिकोत्तर शिष्यवृत्ती योजना
ministry: OBC SEBC VJNT & SBC Welfare Department Government of Maharashtra
department: Directorate of Other Backward Bahujan Kalyan
target_audience: OBC Students pursuing Diploma Degree or Post-Graduate studies
description: Comprehensive scholarship covering 100% tuition fees exam fees and maintenance allowance for eligible Other Backward Class students across Maharashtra colleges.
benefits_summary: 100% tuition and exam fee waiver + monthly maintenance allowance up to Rs 1200.

title: Mukhyamantri Yuva Karya Prashikshan Yojana
title_mr: मुख्यमंत्री युवा कार्य प्रशिक्षण योजना (लाडका भाऊ योजना)
ministry: Skill Development Employment and Entrepreneurship Department Maharashtra
department: Directorate of Vocational Education and Training
target_audience: Youth aged 18 to 35 seeking 6-month on-the-job industrial apprenticeship
description: State internship initiative providing monthly stipends up to Rs 10000 to 12th pass ITI Diploma and Graduate youth during industrial training with accredited private and public sector enterprises.
benefits_summary: Monthly government stipend: Rs 6000 (12th pass) Rs 8000 (Diploma/ITI) Rs 10000 (Degree/PG) for 6 months.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Government of India
target_audience: Small and Marginal Landholder Farmer Families
description: Central Sector scheme providing income support of Rs 6000 per year in three equal 4-monthly installments directly to bank accounts of landholding farmers.
benefits_summary: Direct financial benefit of Rs 6000 per year credited in three installments of Rs 2000 each.

title: Stand-Up India Scheme for Greenfield Enterprises
ministry: Ministry of Finance Government of India
target_audience: SC ST and Women Entrepreneurs setting up new greenfield enterprises
description: Facilitates bank loans between Rs 10 Lakhs and Rs 1 Crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield manufacturing services or trading enterprises.
benefits_summary: Collateral-facilitated bank loans from Rs 10 Lakhs to Rs 1 Crore with composite credit and margin support.

title: [DEMO] Chief Minister Higher Fellowship Program
target_audience: Experienced Professionals and Post-Graduates aged 25 to 30
description: A prestigious 1-year governance fellowship placed directly with District Collectors and State Administrative Departments.
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend of Rs 75000 + Rs 5000 travel allowance.
